We have supply limit: allowed army sizes [3,2]; current armies: castle-black size2 uses one slot, so we have one slot left maybe for size up to 3. Actually supply icons =1, means max total units =? supply limit says allowedArmySizes [3,2]; we have one army of size2, remaining allowed size3. We have no units elsewhere except single unit regions karhand and narrow sea each count as single unit not army? They are single-unit regions, don't use slot. We can muster new units up to supply safe new units when chosen alone 3. Mustering points 2 allow up to 2 recruitments? I think each mustering point allows one unit. So we can recruit up to 2 units. Best to strengthen castle Black (has 2 knights) maybe add footman there to increase army size to 3, staying within supply. Or recruit ship at bay of ice to gain naval mobility. Our supply only 1, adding footman uses 1 supply, fine. Could also recruit a knight (cost 2) not allowed due supply cost? unitCosts knight 2 supply tokens? Actually unitCosts: knight 2 supply tokens (cost). We have only 1 supply, so can only recruit footman or ship (cost1). So recruit footman at winterfell (land) to later move? But we have no march orders this round (mustering phase). Mustering now, later orders next round. Better to place footman at winterfell to later march to castle black or karhold. So recruit footman at winterfell. That's one unit; we have one more mustering point; could recruit ship at bay-of-ice to get naval presence. Might be useful. Choose two recruitments: footman at winterfell, ship at bay-of-ice. Mustering region is winterfell, we can recruit multiple destinations. So use muster_units tool.

We need place-orders for remaining regions (bay-of-ice, winterfell already used? winterfell has no order this round? we used muster, now need orders for all eligible regions count 5. Currently we have orders for castle-black, karhold, the-narrow-sea. Need also bay-of-ice and winterfell. Provide assignments. Choose priorities. We have supply 1, have units: winterfell footman, ship at bay-of-ice, knights at castle-black and karhold defended. Likely want march from winterfell to something? But winterfell is home with castle level2, maybe want defense there. Bay-of-ice is sea with ship can support naval? Could do raid? No enemy adjacent? Adjacent to castle-black, flints-finger, greywater-watch, port-of-winterfell, sunset-sea, the-stony-shore, winterfell. Could raid to remove support? Not needed. Could march ship? Ships can't march land. Could consolidate power at bay-of-ice to get token for future. We have 3 power tokens already. Might want defend winterfell. So assign winterfell defense (starred avoid). bay-of-ice consolidate power. Priorities high for winterfell and bay-of-ice. Provide orders.

Now need to bid again? Bidding phase pendingDecision with participating houses includes us and others. We must submit a bid amount. We have 2 power tokens. Submit_bid amount 2.
